import MilneLib.Affine.GaloisQuotientDescent
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientCanonical
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientMorphisms

/-!
# Morphism descent for finite Galois quotients

For separated quasi-compact schemes with semilinear finite Galois actions
and affine orbits, maps of the canonical quotients over the smaller field
correspond to equivariant maps over the extension field. The geometric
quotient and base-change hypotheses are supplied by the canonical quotient
construction. This proves the Hom comparison for these quotients in the
scheme part of Milne III.1.13; quasi-projectivity and coherent-sheaf descent
are separate assertions.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
  [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
  (actX : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X) (actY : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut Y)
  (pX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hactX : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (actX g).hom ≫ pX = pX ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  (hactY : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (actY g).hom ≫ pY = pY ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  (hX : OrbitsInAffineOpen actX) (hY : OrbitsInAffineOpen actY)

/-- The canonical finite Galois quotient construction induces a Hom
equivalence over the two fields. No morphism descent property is assumed. -/
noncomputable def finiteGaloisQuotientHomEquiv :
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let hXK := galois_action_comp_base actX pX hactX
    let hYK := galois_action_comp_base actY pY hactY
    let rX := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX)
    let rY := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY)
    (Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) ≃
      {f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY // ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
        (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom} := by
  dsimp only
  exact IsGeometricQuotient.equivariantHomEquiv
    (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient actX _ _ hX)
    (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient actY _ _ hY)
    (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actX pX hactX hX).w
    (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actY pY hactY hY)
    (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L) hactX hactY

/-- The descended map is characterized uniquely by its composite with the
canonical quotient projection, as a morphism over the smaller field. -/
theorem finiteGaloisQuotient_existsUnique_map
    (f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY)
    (hf : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom) :
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let hXK := galois_action_comp_base actX pX hactX
    let hYK := galois_action_comp_base actY pY hactY
    let rX := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX)
    let rY := (finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY).map
      (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY)
    ∃! v : Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY,
      finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection actX (pX ≫ b) hXK hX ≫ v.left =
        f.left ≫ finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection actY (pY ≫ b) hYK hY := by
  dsimp only
  let e := finiteGaloisQuotientHomEquiv actX actY pX pY hactX hactY hX hY
  refine ⟨e.symm ⟨f, hf⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact IsGeometricQuotient.comp_mapOver_left _ _
      (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actX pX hactX hX).w
      (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actY pY hactY hY).w f hf
  · intro v hv
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply (cancel_epi (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection actX _ _ hX)).mp
    exact hv.trans (IsGeometricQuotient.comp_mapOver_left _ _
      (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actX pX hactX hX).w
      (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois actY pY hactY hY).w
      f hf).symm

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
